parsing_rationale: The document is a functional specification for an Expense Tracker. I have mapped the User Stories to Functional Requirements and Success Criteria. The 'Edge Cases' and 'Clarifications' sections were parsed into constraints and assumptions. 'Key Entities' were extracted as entities. Structural gaps were identified for 'Goals & Objectives' and 'Scope & Out-of-Scope' as they are not explicitly titled sections, although some content exists within requirements.

project_info.brief_explanation: A basic personal expense tracking application allowing users to add, view, and delete expenses with a summary dashboard.
project_info.source_context: User description for a personal tracker without authentication using localStorage.

sections.title: Feature Specification: Expense Tracker
sections.raw_content:
**Feature Branch**: `001-expense-tracker`

**Created**: 2026-06-22

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "I would like to build a basic expense tracking app (add,view,delete expenses) .Track personal expenses with amount ,date,category,and description.Simple dashboard showing recent expenses and basic totals.Do not implement user auth as this is just a personal tracker for myself."

elements.content: System MUST allow users to add a new expense with amount (positive number), date (date picker), category (predefined list), and description (optional text).
System MUST validate that amount is a positive number greater than zero.
System MUST validate that date is provided and, if the date is in the future, display a warning but still allow the expense to be saved.
System MUST provide a predefined list of categories (e.g., Food, Transport, Entertainment, Shopping, Utilities, Other).
System MUST display a list of expenses sorted by date descending (newest first).
System MUST allow users to delete an expense with confirmation.
System MUST display total amount spent across all expenses.
System MUST display count of total expenses.
System MUST persist expenses to localStorage so data survives browser refresh/close.
System MUST load expenses from localStorage on application start.
System MUST show an empty state when no expenses exist.
System MUST update totals in real-time when expenses are added or deleted.
System MUST NOT allow editing/updating existing expenses in v1 (out of scope).
System MUST display the most recent 50 expenses on the dashboard by default and provide a 'Load more' button to reveal older items.
Expense: id (unique), amount (decimal), date (ISO), category (string), description (optional string), createdAt (timestamp).
Category: Predefined list (Food, Transport, Entertainment, Shopping, Utilities, Other).
Users can add an expense in under 30 seconds from dashboard load.
Dashboard totals (total amount, expense count) are always accurate and match the sum of displayed expenses.
Data persists across browser sessions - expenses added in one session are visible in the next.
Single-user personal tracker - no authentication, no multi-user support.
Data stored locally in browser localStorage - no backend, no cloud sync.

structural_gaps.remediation_advice: Create a dedicated section for Scope. Although FR-013 mentions out-of-scope items, a formal boundary list is needed.
